name: agent-swarm-orchestration
description: Decides when multiple AI agents will help, divides independent work safely, and reconciles one accountable answer.

interface.longDescription: Choose when multiple agents earn their coordination cost, divide work under explicit ownership and authority, reconcile reported findings against evidence, and return one accountable result without pretending that dispatch equals verification.
defaultPrompt: Choose the lightest capable topology, coordinate the work, and return one evidence-bounded result.
Split these independent areas safely, keep one writer per mutable surface, and reconcile every return.
Recover this stalled swarm from the first unearned edge without discarding accepted work.
